headline: Wall Street advances; Nvidia shares soar more than 30% on Jensen Huang's return
summary: Wall Street advanced, with the Nasdaq up more than 7% after a sell-off in technology stocks the previous session. Nvidia shares jumped more than 30% following Jensen Huang's return as chief executive.
why: The Nasdaq is heavily weighted toward large technology companies, so moves in leading AI chip stocks have an outsized effect on the index.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Nvidia's shares rose more than 30% on the leadership news and carry a large index weight.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A technology sell-off in the prior session was followed by a rebound led by Nvidia, whose shares jumped more than 30% after Jensen Huang's return as CEO.
original_headline: Wall Street avanza; acciones de Nvidia se disparan más de 30% por regreso de Jensen Huang
